title: Choose the honest recovery
when: When QA fails, its definition is wrong, a case cannot be performed, or a current gate remains unsatisfied.
need: Retry collects new evidence; correction changes the definition through supported currency rules; waiver records a justified exception; supersession requires a replacement obligation. None rewrites a failure as a pass. A corrected plan supersedes the post_deploy rows its new case replaced, and an item removed from its run retires a broken source in favor of the corrected one, so a corrected case that passes closes the item without a waiver.
surface: Named QA refusals; requirement state and correction reference
gap: Recovery depth exists but is scattered. Review question: should JOURNEYS add failed-or-stale-QA as a situation with a short agent diagnosis and one exact next step?
